title: After 8 years, Europe's BepiColombo mission is on final approach to Mercury
summary: "Fundamentally, we want to learn about the origins of this planet and how it came to be like it is."
llm_summary: After eight years of travel and multiple gravity‑assist flybys, ESA’s BepiColombo spacecraft is now entering its final approach to Mercury. The mission’s twin probes will map the planet’s surface, magnetic field and interior, aiming to uncover how Mercury formed and why it differs so dramatically from Earth and its planetary neighbors. This data will help scientists piece together the early history of the inner Solar System.
